<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex89022024-11-08-14-212" status="unreviewed">
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4025"><expan>slob dpon</expan>drug po</rs><!--gtsang drug pa rdo rje 'od zer?--> na re | 'du byed ni 'bad rtsol <lb n="47a3"/>yin pas 'du byed med pa'i sgra mi 'jug go ||
        'di ni dbang po rdul yang sngon goms pa'i stobs kyis 'bad rtsol nas chung pa la byo' gsung ngo || 
         gnas tsaM dus mi 'pho ba la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4025"><expan>slob dpon</expan> drug po</rs><!--gtsang drug pa rdo rje 'od zer?--> na re | sngar gyi de ltar song na bsam gtan sel ma gsum yel du bsgom pa de 'bras bu che man chad
        <lb n="47a4"/> skye bar 'gyur bsam gtan se la ma sgom pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
